annotations.title: QR code generator: a QR code as SVG for any text or URL

description: Generate a QR code for a URL or any text (UTF-8, up to 1,000 characters) as a scalable SVG plus a ready-to-embed data URL, at error correction L, M (default), Q or H. Use to put a link, Wi-Fi string or payment request on a page, label or ticket. Example: text=https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
